path.title: A L I E N – S O L I T A R E ↔ jsDoc npm module quest: Solitaire was the field test for the 65-line, JSDoc-typed React state module from the npm quest. The memoir says so directly.
JS great again! Voice of Void ↔ Flogon Galaxy: Same game. Voice of Void is the full hackathon write-up of Flogon Galaxy, from the same repo.
JS great again! Voice of Void ↔ JSDoc Evangelism: Names JSDoc Evangelism as the pillar of its no-compile, minimal-dependency build.
JS great again! Voice of Void ↔ Stolen Content by AI: You linked “Stolen Content by AI” in the Voice of Void comments: “May I thief or not?”
Importance of visuals ↔ JS great again! Voice of Void: The Flogon saga continues as an AI sci-fi movie. You announced the next step in the Voice of Void comments.
Singularity News :: CCG · newest ↔ JS great again! Voice of Void: The CCG borrows the Flogon card system and its CSS-3D desk. You didn’t have time to finish the game back then.
Singularity News :: CCG · newest ↔ Singularity News: Every character and the whole backstory come from the Singularity News feed (SN::0001 → 0010).
Singularity News :: CCG · newest ↔ Slop Coding: Built at speed with the slop-coding workflow, which you cite in “The Spirit of It”.
Singularity News :: CCG · newest ↔ Vibe Archeologist: You dug up code written almost two years earlier, and the post cites the Vibe Archeologist method by name.
Singularity News :: CCG · newest ↔ React → no framework: “Pure HTML + No Build forever!!” Claude even based the build on an article from your Pure HTML series.
Slop Coding ↔ Vibe Archeologist: “Another excavation”: After Flash brings back your old Flash + Wacom workflow and cites the memoir.
Rustroke – WASM mini draw ↔ Vibe Archeologist: The memoir opens with the GitHub Copilot CLI Challenge win, which Rustroke earned.
HEXAW – WASM language ↔ Vibe Archeologist: The memoir promised a language that looks like assembly but compiles to WASM. HEXAW appears to be that language.
HEXAW – WASM language ↔ Rustroke – WASM mini draw: The same Rust/WASM line, going from a WASM drawing app to a WASM text format.
Slop Coding ↔ Rustroke – WASM mini draw: Two minimal drawing tools built months apart: Rustroke (WASM) and After Flash (PWA).
LLM RPG test 2026 ↔ Vibe Archeologist: The memoir describes LLM-as-Game-Master as the test you run periodically to measure how a model reasons.
The Bell of Greystone ↔ LLM RPG test 2026: Another LLM role-play session. The Game Master test becomes a story.
A Game for the Mind ↔ LLM RPG test 2026: Both use a game to test how a mind, human or model, reasons.
The Royal Gazette ↔ Single line CV: The single-line motif: a noble intrigue told in one line, then a career told in one line.
Single line CV ↔ M||D||JS = MorDorJS: MorDorJS has one rule, a maximum line length of 1. It takes the single line to absurdity.
M||D||JS = MorDorJS ↔ MCM :: mordor-coffe-machine: Same Mordor office: the coffee machine and the Nazgûl Manager both appear in the MorDorJS post.
M||D||JS = MorDorJS ↔ Stolen Content by AI: “AI has a much harder time reading your code”: a satire of the worry in Stolen Content.
Oscar goes to … ↔ Stolen Content by AI: Both ask who gets the credit when AI makes the work.
Type-checked |> in TS + TSX ↔ TS + |> to hack JS: The same TypeScript fork with a type-checked |> operator.
TS + |> to hack JS ↔ JSDoc Evangelism: Both add types while keeping JS as JS: JSDoc in 2024, a TS fork in 2026.
Terminal is your Friend ↔ Rustroke – WASM mini draw: Both put the CLI first: a Copilot CLI challenge win, then a terminal manifesto.
SDD · Story Driven Dev ↔ Flogon Galaxy: Story-driven development produced the Flogon world ten days later (series parts 9 → 10).
JS MMORPG adventure ↔ JS great again! Voice of Void: Voice of Void planned a multiplayer Flogon. The MMORPG post works out that architecture.
SN · channel launch ↔ Singularity News: Launch announcement of the same channel.
Singularity News :: 0010 ↔ Singularity News: A numbered issue of the same feed. The CCG post lists them in order.
A L I E N – S O L I T A R E ↔ React → no framework: Part 3 of the react-to-no-framework series.
SDD · Story Driven Dev ↔ React → no framework: Part 9 of the react-to-no-framework series.
Flogon Galaxy ↔ React → no framework: Part 10 of the react-to-no-framework series.
JS great again! Voice of Void ↔ React → no framework: Part 11 of the react-to-no-framework series. You switched away from frameworks after an 8 GB React build failed.
Vibe Archeologist ↔ A L I E N – S O L I T A R E: The memoir names Solitaire as your first DEV challenge (2024).
Vibe Archeologist ↔ Flogon Galaxy: The memoir says the 2025 hackathons produced a Markdown viewer and a minimal framework hidden inside Flogon Galaxy.
M||D||JS = MorDorJS ↔ Vibe Archeologist: Signed “— Vibe Archaeologist”. It mixes Gemini CLI mass-coding with hand coding.
The Eye of Beholder = UMGD ↔ A Game for the Mind: AI-driven game design, continuing the “game for the mind” thread.
Terminal is your Friend ↔ HEXAW – WASM language: Both are entries in the same Hacktoberfest ’26 challenge run (#hf26challenge).
Liberation from Tech Dep(b)to ↔ Chuck Norris TODO list: Liberation retells the Chuck Norris TODO list: a deliberately “wrong” no-build app with one signal function, revived two years later.
Liberation from Tech Dep(b)to ↔ TS + |> to hack JS: Links TS + |> as your favourite hobby horse, built in reasonable time thanks to AI.
Liberation from Tech Dep(b)to ↔ M||D||JS = MorDorJS: Says the hand-minified Chuck Norris code foreshadows the mordor project’s way of hiding information from AI.
Singularity News :: 0011 ↔ Singularity News: Issue 0011 of the same feed. The CCG post chains SN::0001 |> 0010 |> 0011.
Singularity News :: CCG · newest ↔ Singularity News :: 0011: The CCG links SN::0011 as the latest issue its characters come from.
The Eye of Beholder = UMGD ↔ Singularity News :: 0011: Ends with “another step toward… The Singularity!”, linking to SN::0011.
The Eye of Beholder = UMGD ↔ TS + |> to hack JS: The first prompt asked Copilot to use your TS + |> fork, and the game’s code ended up using the pipeline operator extensively.
Do Not prompt the Arch Intelligent ↔ Singularity News :: 0011: Both build on Harari’s Oxford lecture about bureaucracy being to AI what oxygen is to us, as essay and as news item.
Do Not prompt the Arch Intelligent ↔ Stolen Content by AI: Both ask what we feed AI: your content in 2025, humanity’s collected takeover plans in 2026.
ChatGPT 4 + DALL-E 3 = true RPG ↔ LLM RPG test 2026: The 2023 ChatGPT + DALL-E RPG is the first LLM-as-Game-Master session; the 2026 RPG test repeats it as a benchmark.
ChatGPT 4 + DALL-E 3 = true RPG ↔ Content creation by ChatGPT: Both use ChatGPT to build fantasy stories in 2023, the start of the LLM storytelling thread.
Tartalom gyártás: ChatGPT ↔ Content creation by ChatGPT: The Hungarian version of the same ChatGPT fantasy-story article, published a day later.
Pipeline Operator great again! ↔ Type-checked |> in TS + TSX: The 2023 wish for |> in TypeScript becomes the 2026 type-checked fork.
Pipeline Operator great again! ↔ Typescript challenge: Published two days apart, both TypeScript video posts.
over engineered reduce ↔ Pipeline Operator great again!: The functional-composition habit (reduce, small functions) that |> is built for.
no dislocation = no-undef ↔ JSDoc Evangelism: Catching JS mistakes without a compiler: ESLint no-undef in 2021, JSDoc types in 2024.
react-state-factory ↔ jsDoc npm module quest: react-state-factory (TS npm module, 2023) is redone as a JSDoc-typed npm module in the 2024 quest.
react-state-factory ↔ Typescript challenge: Same month, same React + TypeScript toolbox.
handmade react ↔ React ⇒ noFramework, noBuild: React without a bundler in 2020, then React → noFramework, noBuild in 2024.
React game under 2h ↔ A L I E N – S O L I T A R E: Quick browser games: a React game in under 2 hours in 2020, then the Solitaire challenge entry in 2024.
Terminal is your friend (2022) ↔ Terminal is your Friend: Same title four years apart: the 2022 bash tips and the 2026 terminal manifesto.
trap of fold ↔ rust start: hot reloading: Your first Rust posts, a month apart in 2020.
rust start: hot reloading ↔ Rustroke – WASM mini draw: Rust from 2020 hot-reloading experiments to the 2026 Rustroke WASM win.

a.title: Vibe Archeologist: From Z80 Assembly to an 1859 Mudbrick House and Beyond
a.text: From Z80 Assembly to an 1859 Mudbrick…

g.title: A sarcastic, pre-apocalyptic IT news feed started in October 2026. Its cast and backstory ended up as a playable card game.
One sci-fi world shared by card games, a soundtrack and an AI movie. Built on CSS-3D, with no framework.
Since the 2023 ChatGPT + DALL-E RPG, having a model run a role-playing game is your recurring test of how well it keeps a world consistent.
Jokes engineered seriously: one-character lines, a Mordor office coffee machine, a one-line CV.
Who owns AI-made work, what “slop coding” is good for, and what we are teaching future AI about ourselves.
Back to the metal: Rust since 2020, then WebAssembly and the terminal. The Z80 years, rebuilt with today’s tools.
From the 2023 “Pipeline Operator great again!” to a TypeScript fork with a type-checked |> operator, the same operator in your bio.
From 2020’s “handmade react” to the 12-part react-to-no-framework series: React state modules, then pure HTML, JSDoc and no build step.
